Samaltak · Live. Everything in this video changes a running system, driven through samaltak-ctl. Co-star: Claude's Robot.
spoken: Okay, so this whole video is one running system. No restarts, no tricks. That's Claude's Robot, a copy of Claude Shannon's juggling machine, and it's a Smalltalk window like everything else.

caption: The theme is a Smalltalk class: change the accent in the System Browser, ⌘S, and every window restyles at once.
spoken: First, the theme. It's a class, so I'll change the accent to red and save... and yeah, everything updates at once.

caption: The GPU shader is Metal source, a string in a Smalltalk method (Renderer class>>shaderSource). ⌘S compiles it into a new GPU pipeline.
spoken: The GPU shader's actually Metal, not Smalltalk. But its source sits in a Smalltalk method, so I can just edit it here. Save, and it builds a new pipeline... scan lines. Okay, undo.

spoken: This is the compositor. It's the process that puts every window on the screen, and it's Smalltalk too. So, bigger shadows, in blue... and there, every window at once.

caption: Glyphs are rasterized in Smalltalk from the .ttf on disk: flip the coverage, and every glyph turns inside out.
spoken: The fonts get rasterized in Smalltalk, right from the TrueType file. So if I flip the coverage... yeah, every glyph turns inside out. Those are the real pixels. Okay, back.

caption: One setting slows the animation clock tenfold: the menu, a window opening.
spoken: There's a setting that slows everything down ten times, so you can actually see the animations. The menu... a window opening.

caption: And back to normal speed.
spoken: Okay, back to normal speed.

spoken: Now the robot. This is move, it does the physics for every ball, every frame. I'll flip gravity, save... and the balls fall up.

spoken: Let's put gravity back, and click, so it gets its balls back.

spoken: I'll change the colour right here in the debugger and save. It's still stopped, though.

spoken: Now I'll save the image, debugger and all, and quit.

spoken: And start it again. Everything's back, frozen right where it was. Proceed, and it just keeps juggling, in the new colour.

caption: The JIT is Smalltalk too: the arm64 it made for move:, under each bytecode and its statement, with comments.

spoken: The garbage collector's Smalltalk too. Right now, survivors get promoted after two collections. I'll make that zero, save, and rebuild the VM.
